sales_hooks: TSMC CoWoS is the chokepoint of the entire AI supply chain — every HBM supplier must co-package through TSMC. Qualification on CoWoS-S/L directly determines which memory sells into NVIDIA GPUs.
CoWoS capacity expanding from 85K WPM (2025) to 120K WPM (2026E) — each new WPM slot represents committed HBM demand. Ask what TSMC's expansion pace means for your customer's production planning.
TSMC N2 ramp in 2025-2026 = next NVIDIA GPU generation = next HBM generation pull. Timing TSMC node ramp with HBM roadmap is the key synchronization challenge.
TSMC Indiana fab (Phoenix) + Japan fab = geopolitical HBM packaging diversification opportunity. Micron (US-based) uniquely positioned here vs Korean suppliers.

competitive_position.vs_samsung_foundry: Samsung advanced packaging far behind on CoWoS equivalent; no credible NVIDIA alternative
competitive_position.vs_intel_foundry: Intel 18A CoWoS alternative in very early stages; not a near-term threat
competitive_position.moat: 18-month CoWoS lead time creates a structural lock-in; customers must commit capacity 6+ quarters ahead

scm_engagement.scm_role: Manufactures all advanced AI GPU/ASIC dies AND performs CoWoS advanced packaging (bonding HBM stacks to GPU dies). TSMC is the only supplier capable of both steps at volume, making it the single most critical chokepoint in the AI hardware supply chain.

server_products.name: CoWoS-S (GPU + HBM interposer)
server_products.used_in: NVIDIA H100/H200/B200, AMD MI300X/MI325X, Google TPU v5
server_products.note: Bonds GPU die + HBM stacks on a silicon interposer. 50K+ WPM capacity in 2025. 18-month lead time.

server_products.name: CoWoS-L (multi-die, large interposer)
server_products.used_in: NVIDIA GB200 (Grace CPU + Blackwell GPU + NVLink chiplets)
server_products.note: Larger interposer for multi-chip modules. Required for Grace Blackwell Superchip (GB200).

server_products.name: N3E/N3P Die (3nm GPU wafer)
server_products.used_in: NVIDIA Blackwell GPU die, Apple M4
server_products.note: NVIDIA Blackwell uses TSMC N4 for compute die, N3 for components. Highest-demand node in 2025-2026.

server_products.name: N4P Die (4nm GPU wafer)

lead_time.description: TSMC new capacity decision → tokens served ≈ 18-24 months. Adding CoWoS capacity requires clean room construction (12-18 months), equipment delivery (6-12 months), and yield ramp (3-6 months). Existing capacity turns 3 months.
lead_time.bottleneck: EUV scanner delivery from ASML (12-18 month wait) + clean room construction
